# Expected values for the digger (docs/rules/digging.md), captured from the original program in the emulator (ADR 0008):
# tools/GhidraDump/emulate.py, the verb construct (remove with the phase routine 0x42965c at the last phase of each cycle), run to the pass
# the scenario names. The click b@x,y,T places the site of the type T at the pass AT; the type 0x11 is the sawmill, a large type, whose site
# waits at the progress word 0 until the node and its six neighbours lie at the site's height (0x42d328), and the ground of that map near the
# castle is not level, so the castle's digger (the settler of the slot 13, job 2) walks out to it and works for 1350 passes.
# A line "pass=N ..." gives, as the emulator left them after the pass N: the 16 bytes of the digger (s13; the verb prints a settler only at the
# passes where its bytes change, so between two lines they hold), the first 14 bytes of the building item of the site (b2: the status at 5
# and the progress word at 12), and the heights the pass changed (h=x,y:old>new, decimal). The building slot is one higher than the engine's
# (the dummy of the table); the settler slots are the same.
# The lines stop at the pass 1959, where the digger has gone into the castle again. The building item is listed up to the pass 1700: later
# the site's flag asks for materials, which the engine's hand-out lays on the castle's flag at once where the original's first settler carries
# them out (docs/rules/construction-materials.md).
# Not production code: no routine of the program is transcribed here, only values the program produced.

# The same verdict sweep (the click v@0,0, as below) before the pass 1960, when the digger has gone into the castle again and the site has
# started (its status byte 5 is 0x40 and its progress word 1, as the line b2 of the pass 1910 and the verb's building item show). Like
# the sweeps below, the line holds the nodes with the node state 4 to 7: the four nodes the verb also lists with the state 1 or 3 (the
# flags 16,6, 18,6, and 15,9 and the site's own node 14,8) are left out.
# sweep-site-started construct:1:1234,5678,9ABC:25:15,5:18,6;15,9:16,6,00;16,6,2223::40:1961:b@14,8,17;1960=v@0,0

# The build-site evaluator's verdict on every node of the castle's land while the sawmill's site waits for its digger (the click v@0,0: the
# classification 0x44b6e6 of each tile, as "x,y:node/site/height": the node state, the site, and the height the evaluator leaves, the word
